subject: Evaluation kickoff & technical deep-dive — proposed times and trial plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Hart <sarah.hart@finlytics.com>, Timothy Nguyen <timothy.nguyen@finlytics.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 14:23:00 -0800
Subject: Evaluation kickoff & technical deep-dive — proposed times and trial plan

Hi Sarah / Tim,

Thanks again for taking the discovery call today — appreciate the context on your latency targets and the three core evaluation goals (accuracy on financial extraction, 99th percentile latency under 450ms, and predictable token costs). Based on what we covered, I put together a short trial plan and a set of next steps so we can get the evaluation started quickly:

Summary of next steps (proposed)
- Schedule a 60min evaluation kickoff: demo + technical deep dive with your ML infra owner (CTO or platform lead) + our SEs (Dev).
- Share a sample prompt set and expected labels (attached: finlytics_prompt_set_v1.csv).
- Run a 2-week sandbox trial on a dedicated instance (we recommend the "balanced-4" configuration for your throughput profile).
- Define success criteria: accuracy threshold (F1 >= 0.88 on transaction extraction), P99 latency < 450ms, and cost / inference token target (TBD during kickoff).

Proposed kickoff windows (Pacific time) — please pick one or suggest alternatives:
- Mon 23 Feb: 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Tue 24 Feb: 09:00–10:00 or 13:00–14:00
- Wed 25 Feb: 11:00–12:00

I attached the evaluation plan (redwood_eval_plan_v1.pdf) and a short SOC2 summary (soc2_summary.pdf) you requested for procurement. Once you confirm a time, I’ll send a calendar invite and a short pre-read for the kickoff (agenda + access checklist).

Quick ask: can you confirm the list of attendees you want on the kickoff (CTO/Platform/ML owner + 1 product manager)? Also let me know if there are any internal compliance reviewers we should include in the invite.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: finlytics_prompt_set_v1.csv, redwood_eval_plan_v1.pdf, soc2_summary.pdf

From: Sarah Hart <sarah.hart@finlytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Timothy Nguyen <timothy.nguyen@finlytics.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:11:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff & technical deep-dive — proposed times and trial plan

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and the materials. Quick answers:
- The success criteria look right; we'll define exact cost targets in the kickoff but the F1 and latency goals match our internal OKRs.
- Attendees: I’ll be on the call, and I’ve asked Michael Chen (CTO) to join as the ML/platform owner. Timothy will coordinate with procurement if we need the SOC2 evidence.

On timing: Mon 23 Feb at 15:00 PT looks best for Michael and me. If that works for your team, please lock it. If the calendar slot is already tight, Tue 24 Feb 09:00 PT is our second choice.

One additional question before kickoff: can you confirm whether the sandbox will run within a VPC (we need to ensure egress controls) and whether we can get temporary read-only access to logs during the trial for regression analysis. Also, do you have a quick summary of data retention during trials? I didn’t see it in the SOC2 summary.

Also, Timothy asked if you could share a high-level list of what the SE will want from our side (sample dataset, API keys, any IP/cert questions).

Thanks,
Sarah
Head of Product | FinLytics
sarah.hart@finlytics.com | +1 212-555-0133

Thanks Sarah — booked for Mon 23 Feb at 15:00 PT. Calendar invite sent: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-finlytics-eval-kickoff

Agenda (60m)
- 0–10m: Introductions & success criteria alignment (Marissa, Sarah, Michael)
- 10–30m: Live demo of inference flow + Q&A (Marissa + Dev)
- 30–45m: Technical deep-dive (Dev): model variants, latency profiles, KV/prefix caching, and sandbox topology (VPC options)
- 45–55m: Trial logistics: access, dataset/samples, timeline, and rollback policies (Logan)
- 55–60m: Confirm deliverables & action items

Pre-reads: redwood_eval_plan_v1.pdf (attached) and the prompt set you shared (received — thanks). Per your compliance question: the sandbox can be provisioned inside your VPC via our Private Connector; we can also provide temporary read-only log access scoped to the trial instance. Data retention during trials defaults to 30 days; we can adjust that via contract if needed — I’ll have our security contact share a one-pager in advance.

What we need from you before the kickoff:
- A sample of ~200 labeled prompts (CSV) — we have yours and will use a subset but anything else you want us to prioritize, paste to the shared Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/finlytics-sandbox
- Confirm who will own API key distribution and whether you want us to provision keys or integrate with your KMS during the trial.

HubSpot deal updated: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DL-2026-0473

If anything changes on your side, flag me and I’ll adjust. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Marissa

Hi Sarah / Michael — quick note from the SE side ahead of the kickoff:

Agenda notes for the technical deep-dive:
- Walk through the sandbox topology (VPC peering vs private connector) and the steps to grant read-only log access.
- Discuss model variant recommendations for financial extraction (quantized LLM + reranker for entity linking).
- Confirm expected throughput and burst behaviour so we size the instance correctly.
- Ask for two sample prompts that represent worst-case length and one that demonstrates the multi-field extraction we’ll eval.

If you can drop the two samples into the Drive folder or paste them in reply, that’ll speed up the setup post-kickoff. I’ll also prepare a short runbook we can hand off to your infra team.
